arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# Treasury data - Calendar years, Series E and EE, Interest-bearing debt (in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724  # from calendar year 1992
debt_1993 = 158633  # from calendar year 1993
debt_1994 = 166731  # from calendar year 1994

# CPI-U annual averages (official BLS data)
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Convert to constant 1994 dollars
# Formula: adjusted_value = nominal_value * (CPI_1994 / CPI_year)
adj_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adj_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adj_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # This equals the original value

print('Inflation-adjusted values in constant 1994 dollars:')
print(f'1992: {adj_1992:.2f} million')
print(f'1993: {adj_1993:.2f} million')
print(f'1994: {adj_1994:.2f} million')

# Calculate mean
values = [adj_1992, adj_1993, adj_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f'\\nMean: {mean:.2f}')

# Calculate sample standard deviation (using n-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f'Sample std dev (n-1): {std_dev:.2f}')

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adj_1994 - mean) / std_dev
print(f'\\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.4f}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {z_score:.2f}')
"
